append.observe: Delivered copies leave out what they would only repeat. In public_robot_facts a camera entry omits native_pixel_to_image_offset_xy when it is [0, 0] and image_view when it is that camera's own name; end effectors omit orientation_order and controlled_frame, because every pose is [x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw] of the controlled point the embodiment card names. In last_action_effect.detail an arm that was not targeted lists only its non-null fields, and its inactive_arm_drift only above 0.1 mm or 0.01 deg. A claim_boundary, evidence_scope or note whose fixed text a tool's description states is left out of that tool's results and effects. An arm's gripper.feedback.arrival_check omits tolerance_normalized when it equals controller_feedback.gripper_tolerance_normalized.
append.move_pose: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: compiled_pose.targets.<arm>.observed_clearance.claim_boundary (move_pose, move_to, rotate_wrist and rotate_pitch) is "From the current depth images and their calibration only; points inside the measured jaws, the held object and the space above them are excluded as robot, other robot links are not; occluded surfaces and object undersides are unknown; points up to the footprint's top within radius_m count; not a collision check or a contact prediction, and the move is submitted unchanged."; last_action_effect.detail.arms.<arm>.planning_diagnostics.evidence_scope of a one-arm move is "One bounded SDK IK solve, endpoint FK checks and the SDK collision spheres sampled along the straight joint interpolation for self-collision and against the other arm at its measured joints (finger links are not in the sphere model); no scene, table, payload or task-success proof."; last_action_effect.detail.arms.<arm>.planning_diagnostics.evidence_scope of a two-arm move is "One bounded SDK IK solve, endpoint FK checks and the SDK collision spheres sampled along the straight joint interpolation for self-collision; no scene, table, payload or task-success proof."; compiled_pose.targets.<arm>.reach_along_request.claim_boundary of an unsolved target is "Read-only IK on the route move_pose takes, from the measured joints, at sampled points of the straight interpolation to the target; reachability is not proven monotone between samples, and no path, collision, payload or arrival claim."; reach_along_request.nearest_reachable_orientation.claim_boundary is "Read-only IK at each candidate endpoint on the route this move takes, from the measured joints: the requested orientation turned about axes perpendicular to its approach axis, holding the nominal jaw centre; no path, collision, payload or arrival claim, and an orientation outside the sweep may solve.".
append.vision_segment: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: the result's claim_boundary is "independent point-prompt proposals with a per-point mask budget; one point never consumes another point's masks, an empty point means no mask at that pixel rather than an exhausted budget, and omitted_over_* counts every mask withheld; inspect the proposals and choose semantic identity; crops add no sensor detail".
append.set_gripper: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: the action effect's gripper_outcome.claim_boundary is "stalled_before_target means the jaws stopped short of the commanded opening; it is consistent with an object between the fingers and is not proof of a grasp".
append.grasp_plan: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: ik_reachability.claim_boundary is "IK reference at planning time for the compiled pregrasp (free_space from the measured joints) and approach (contact_approach from that pregrasp solution), trying the exact orientation and its 180-degree jaw flip; not a guarantee. Execution runs its own backend check, and any world action stales this."; ik_reachability.jaw_symmetry.claim_boundary is "Joint-limit margins of the backend's read-only IK solutions for the published pregrasp and contact poses at planning time; joint6 is the X5 wrist roll about the approach axis and is reported only when the measured joints prove it is the binding joint. An IK reference, not a carry guarantee: execution solves again, and lifting, carrying or rotating the wrist after the grasp moves every margin.".
append.grasp_execute: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: the result's claim_boundary is "one committed sequence of trusted executions and the public measurements taken after it; motion arrival and jaw separation beside visible extents are evidence, not grasp, placement, retention or official task success"; precommit_motion_check.claim_boundary (also in a grasp_pregrasp_unreachable refusal) is "Current-state planning/admission for the probed stages, with the selected backend's collision coverage. Does not certify contact, lift, retention or task success; execution revalidates after opening."; last_action_effect.detail.verification.claim_boundary is "jaw separation beside visible extents is evidence, not a holding verdict; no value of this pair establishes contact or retention"; last_action_effect.detail.verification.lift_probe.claim_boundary is "short_lift_evidence_only;not_attachment_or_stable_transport_or_task_success"; last_action_effect.detail.verification.jaw_hold.claim_boundary is "normalized jaw-encoder readings under the backend drive limiter; not a calibrated aperture, contact, attachment, retention or task-success verdict".
append.wait_ticks: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: last_action_effect.detail.wait.claim_boundary is "time passed with commands held; drift, settling, slip or scripted scene motion are measured evidence in the fresh observation, not effects of this action".
